football_pitch_m2.definition: Standard comparison pitch 105m x 68m. Sources vary in what they call a 'football pitch'; the Observatory uses this definition throughout and comparisons can be turned off in the UI.

household_annual_electricity_kwh.definition: Ofgem typical domestic consumption value (medium user, electricity only). Used for household-equivalent comparisons; shown as an approximation.

olympic_pool_m3.definition: Nominal 50m x 25m x 2m Olympic swimming pool volume, for water-use comparisons.

gb_demand_connection_queue_gw.source: Ofgem, Proposed Data Centre Connection Reforms consultation, 29 July 2026
gb_demand_connection_queue_gw.note: Up from 41 GW Nov 2024; ~80 GW attributed to data centres. No public project-level demand register exists.
